sources.title: Exact monetary target, measurement and selective-note constructions
sources.author: Causal banking research project
sources.source_identity: Project-authored rational calculations; not empirical bank or provider evidence

local_copy.anchor: calculate: funding ledger, rates, timing, nonlinear valuation, selection and binary measurement

inspected_anchors.finding: Average balances, dollar-days, incremental expense and existing-balance repricing are distinct; value and cost signs reconcile.
Equal balance means need not determine monetary value.
Random assignment can have selected-note contrast 1/2 at zero effect; differential classification can reverse the observed contrast.

supported_claims: Exact stipulated counterexamples and funding identities under the explicit fixed requirement, rate and day-count assumptions.
No current market prices, bank return, measured LLM accuracy or generally qualified correction is established.
